newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.

text.p: Company reported third-quarter share earnings fell to $0.51 from $0.71 a year ago. It warned fourth-quarter sales would fall below the third quarter's and said a fourth-quarter loss was possible.
Company reported third-quarter operating share earnings rose to $0.95 from $0.81 a year ago. The First Call consensus was $0.93.

Company reported third-quarter operating share earnings fell to $0.77 from $0.98 a year ago. Aetna said analysts' estimate of $0.95 for its third quarter EPS excludes the company's previously announced after-tax restructuring charge of $31.8 million. It reported net EPS excluding the charge of $0.95, against $0.97 in the third quarter of 1995.
Company reported third-quarter share earnings rose to $0.30 from $0.18 a year ago.

Company reported first-quarter operating share earnings rose to $0.19 from $0.12 a year ago. The First Call consensus was $0.20. Merrill downgraded the stock, noting that Octel management indicated there would be a three- to six-month delay in the release of a software upgrade for its Sierra platform.
Company reported third-quarter share earnings were even with the year-ago's at $0.20.
Company reported third-quarter share earnings rose to $0.48 from $0.42 a year ago. The Zack's mean estimate was $0.49.

Company reported third-quarter share earnings rose to $0.78 from $0.52 a year ago. Gateway said it expects selling, general and administrative expenses to increase in the fourth quarter of 1996, but to continue to decrease as a percent of sales.
Company reported third-quarter share earnings rose to $0.43 from $0.11 a year ago.
Company reported third-quarter operating share earnings fell to $0.85 from $1.05 a year ago. Q3 share net after charges was $0.75.
